title: VP Manufacturing IT
description:
###### **About the position**

  

As VP IT Manufacturing at VAROPreem, you will shape how technology supports safe, reliable and efficient operations across our refineries and terminals. You will lead an organisation of approximately 20 employees, developing the people, applications and digital capabilities that support production, maintenance, logistics and plant operations. Reporting to Susanne Stenman, EVP Data & Information Technology, you will work closely with the EVP Refinery to turn operational priorities into technology investments and measurable business value.


You will combine strategic direction with operational focus, driving standardisation and digital transformation while balancing local requirements with company-wide priorities. Building on an established technology foundation, you will advance the use of analytics, automation and AI to improve operational performance. Your remit covers manufacturing business and support applications, with close collaboration with the separate Operational Technology (OT) organisation.


Location is flexible, with Rotterdam, Stockholm, Göteborg, Hamburg, Baar, Lysekil eller Cressier (Schweiz) as identified as possible bases. The stated working arrangement includes office attendance two days per week. The role is responsible for supporting and developing IT across VAROPreem’s manufacturing operations, working closely with production teams. It includes travel to refineries, terminals and other facilities within the scope of responsibility to maintain close collaboration with local operations, including travel to Lysekil if based elsewhere.


This is an opportunity to bring technology and operations closer together and make a tangible contribution to VAROPreem’s energy business.

**Your respibilities will include**

* Define and deliver the manufacturing IT strategy and technology roadmaps, aligned with safety, operational priorities and long-term business goals.
* Lead the lifecycle management, standardisation and improvement of applications supporting production, maintenance, laboratory, health, safety, security and environment (HSSE), and operational workflows.
* Strengthen refinery and terminal operations through reliable IT solutions that support production continuity, asset visibility and efficient work processes.
* Drive predictive maintenance, advanced analytics, workflow automation and AI-enabled decision support.
* Enable data-driven decisions through structured collection, integration and use of production and asset data.
* Ensure availability, business continuity and recovery capabilities for business-critical manufacturing IT systems.
* Manage manufacturing IT budgets, investments and strategic vendors, with clear accountability for costs and business value.
* Act as the technology partner to manufacturing, refinery, terminal and HSSE leadership, aligning delivery with operational needs.
* Ensure compliance with policies, regulations and security requirements, managing cybersecurity, continuity and data protection risks while supporting sustainability objectives.
* Lead, coach and develop teams, set clear priorities and track results across efficiency, cost, resilience, quality and innovation.

**What we offer**


At VAROPreem, your work has real impact. Together, we deliver the energy society relies on today while shaping the energy solutions of tomorrow. Here, you are part of a company that does not settle for “the way things have always been done.”


We provide the energy and mobility that enable people, industries and societies to thrive. We are supporting Europe’s energy security, and we are looking for people who want to help shape the future of energy. You do this alongside colleagues who are experts in their fields, in an environment where we challenge each other, continuously grow, and win, together. With headquarters in Switzerland and operations across Europe, you will be part of an international organisation with strong opportunities to develop — both in your current role and beyond. We are ambitious and focus on what truly creates impact — for our customers, for each other, and for the communities we serve. If you want to make a difference, and see the results of your work, you will thrive at VAROPreem

**B****ackground and Experience**

* Proven senior leadership experience in manufacturing or industrial IT, preferably within oil and gas, refining, chemicals, utilities or another complex industrial environment.
* Several years of experience managing manufacturing applications, IT platforms and operational digital transformation.
* Experience leading people or functions, including coaching, performance management and organisational development.
* A relevant degree in IT, engineering or industrial management, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing application landscapes, system integration, data platforms and enterprise architecture.
* Experience with refinery or terminal operations and business-critical applications supporting production, maintenance, logistics, laboratory and HSSE processes.
* Understanding of analytics, workflow automation and AI-enabled decision support.
* Experience in IT governance, operational risk, cybersecurity and regulatory compliance in industrial environments.
* Strong understanding of business continuity, operational resilience and availability requirements for critical systems.
* Proven ability to influence operational leaders and technology providers, translating business needs into scalable, standardised IT capabilities.

**Personal characteristics**


You combine a strategic perspective with a practical focus on operational needs and measurable results. Clear in your communication and confident in your decisions, you build trust across business, operations and IT. Your collaborative approach helps you unite stakeholders around shared goals, while your coaching leadership supports team development and change. You balance local requirements with company-wide priorities and pursue innovation without losing sight of safety, stability and compliance.

**Application**


The position reports to Susanne Stenman, EVP Data and Information Technolog. In this recruitment, VAROPreem is working with Novare Executive Search. For more information about the position or the process, please contact Anna Malmström at anna.malmstrom@novare.se.Please note that we do not accept applications by email.

  

As VAROPreem operates services of critical importance to society, a background check and alcohol and drug testing are mandatory prior to any offer of employment. As part of the interview process, candidates must be able to present valid proof of identity, either a passport or national ID card, or alternatively a population registration certificate together with a valid driving licence.  

Certain parts of VAROPreem’s operations are subject to protective security requirements. Therefore, if required for the position, a security vetting process, including a security register check, will be conducted in accordance with the Swedish Protective Security Act.

title: Software Engineer, Front Active Steering
description:
**Software Engineer, Front Active Steering**
--------------------------------------------


Front Active Steering (FAS) is part of Vehicle Dynamics and develops the steering control system. FAS system is actively evolving toward new, more advanced generations.


We are looking for a principal software engineer to drive the automatization and modernize how we build, verify, and release embedded software for the safety critical FAS system.

### **Work Description**

* Build and implement a CI/CD pipeline for the team's embedded software development, replacing manual steps with automated, repeatable workflows.
* Design and maintain tool chains and scripts that run the tools generating C code from our models and configurations, and that execute automated tests before the software is built and released.
* Improve build quality and lead time by identifying bottlenecks in the current manual process and automating them.
* Integrate automated testing (unit, integration, static analysis) into the pipeline so code quality is verified continuously, not just at release time.
* Contribute to improving the software process and way of working, both for the SW pipeline itself and for other development process steps, in line with ISO 26262 requirements for safety-related software.
* Work closely with embedded software developers to understand their workflow and make the pipeline genuinely useful day to day, not just technically correct.

### **Required Competencies**

* 5-10 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tool chains, including Jenkins or equivalent.
* Strong programming skills in Python and C.
* Solid working knowledge of Git (branching, merging strategies, pipeline integration).
* Experience with embedded/automotive software development, code generation tools, or automated test frameworks for C code is meritorious.

### **Personality**

* A self-driven person who takes ownership and can move work forward independently, without needing every step spelled out.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and figure out what "good" looks like for a pipeline that doesn't fully exist yet.
* Bringing ideas, not just execution. Proposes better ways of working, not only implementing what's asked.
* A clear communicator who collaborates well with software engineers who may not be CI/CD experts themselves.

title: Lead Software Engineer – Internal Tooling
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
==============================================

  

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.


We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About the Role**
------------------


You enjoy building software that helps colleagues get their work done. You’re comfortable going from a conversation about a broken process to the code behind a better one, and helping other engineers do the same.


At Tandem, you’ll lead the development of internal products used across the company. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to understand their workflows and agree priorities that support Tandem’s wider goals.


We’re building a small team, so this is a hands-on technical leadership role. You’ll build applications, integrations, and workflow automation, and follow through as colleagues start using them. You’ll also help recruit engineers and support them as they take ownership.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Develop the internal tooling roadmap with stakeholders and engineering leadership, aligning priorities with company initiatives.
* Work directly with stakeholders to understand where their workflows break down and decide where custom software, existing tools, or a process change will help most.
* Build and maintain internal applications, admin interfaces, APIs, and automations that reduce manual work and help colleagues make decisions.
* Connect our systems with third-party software, keeping data consistent and making failed or incomplete updates visible and recoverable.
* Work with business owners to clarify rules, exceptions, and permissions, and agree which parts of a workflow our products should support.
* Set practical engineering standards for the tools we build, including usable interfaces, access controls, validation, audit trails, testing, and careful rollout.
* Work with engineering leadership on hiring needs and help recruit engineers.
* Coach engineers through design and implementation, review their work, and help them take ownership of tools and workflows.
* Balance new work with maintenance and support. Use feedback and actual usage to decide what to improve, replace, or retire, and check whether changes made colleagues’ work easier.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Strong software engineering skills, with experience designing, building, testing, and maintaining production systems.
* Strong skills in data modelling, APIs, integrations, and relational databases.
* The ability to work across backend services and user interfaces, and get up to speed with unfamiliar technologies.
* Experience leading technical work and helping engineers take ownership through coaching, feedback, and code or design review.
* Experience managing stakeholder relationships, aligning competing needs with company priorities, and communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly.
* Judgement about when to build custom software, use an existing tool, or change the underlying process.
* The ability to clarify unfamiliar business rules with their owners and carry work through to adoption and ongoing maintenance.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience establishing or growing a team that builds internal products.
* Experience hiring engineers or identifying and developing missing skills within a team.
* Experience working with Finance, Operations, Commercial, or other business functions, and understanding their processes.
* Experience with access controls, audit trails, or systems that handle sensitive business information.

**Location**
------------


We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.

  

**How to Apply**
----------------


We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.


Our interview process consists of these stages:

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* Technical interviews with one of our engineers
* Interview with Platform Team Lead
* System Design Interview at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch and a Product focused System Design interview to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
* Follow-up interview with our CTO & Co-Founder

  

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*

**Culture at Tandem**
=====================

  

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.


Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.


Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.


We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.  

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Gruppchef Infrastruktur och System
description:
Vi bygger om kommunens IT medan allt är i drift. Den digitala arbetsplatsen förnyas, AI tar över rutinjobb och ny lagstiftning höjer ribban för säkerheten – samtidigt som vi har hela bredden i egen regi.  

  

  

**Tror du att kommunal IT går långsamt?**
-----------------------------------------


  

Det är en vanlig bild och vi förstår den. Men så här ser det ut hos oss just nu:
  

* Bredd som få har kvar. Vi bygger och driver det mesta själva. Hos oss ser du hela kedjan, inte en liten del av den.
* Modernisering i full fart. Vi förnyar den digitala arbetsplatsen för hela kommunen, med säkerheten inbyggd från början.
* AI på riktigt. Hos oss gör AI redan jobb i vardagen, inte bara i pilotprojekt. Vad vi automatiserar härnäst bestämmer vi tillsammans.
* Säkerhet som betyder något. Det vi skyddar är skola, omsorg och samhällsservice för en hel kommun, och ny lagstiftning ger arbetet tyngd.
* Hela koncernen som uppdrag. Vi levererar IT till alla förvaltningar och kommunala bolag, och samordnar nu koncernens IT direkt under kommundirektören, på uppdrag av kommunfullmäktige.
* Arbetssätt med tempo. Enheten är ny sedan 2026. Vi jobbar i sprintar med avsatt tid för utveckling, och du är med och formar hur vi arbetar.

  

Mycket är nytt och en del är inte färdigt, därför söker vi chefen för teamet som står mitt i det här.
  

Här får du ett av de bredaste IT-uppdrag en kommun kan erbjuda, i en organisation som är tillräckligt liten för att du ska se skillnaden du gör.
  

  

IT-chefen sitter i kommunens koncernledningsgrupp, så IT-frågorna har en plats där besluten fattas. Du har nära till beslut, både inom enheten och upp till kommunledningen.  

  

  

**Ditt uppdrag**
----------------


  

Du blir chef för Infrastruktur och system med fullt personal-, arbetsmiljö- och budgetansvar för ett team på elva tekniker som ansvarar för infrastruktur, säkerhet och systemdrift. Teamet håller kommunens grundplattformar igång för omkring 4 000 medarbetare och bygger samtidigt det som kommer härnäst. Vid din sida har du vår arkitekt, som håller ihop sprintplaneringen och de tekniska leveranserna.
  

  

Ditt ledarskap går först men du har också god teknisk förståelse för att ta en diskussion om nätverksdesign, säkerhetsarkitektur eller molnmigrering och landa i ett beslut. I systemförvaltningsmodellen blir du teknisk ägare för IT-enhetens plattformar. Du ingår i IT-enhetens ledningsgrupp och är med och formar enhetens strategi och riktning.
  

  

Vi ska vara ärliga: trycket är högt. Konkret innebär det att du följer ärendeflödet från verksamheterna, hanterar eskaleringar och balanserar planerat arbete mot det oplanerade.
  

  

Flera stora projekt pågår samtidigt och det finns teknisk skuld att arbeta av. En stor del av jobbet är att tillsammans med driftledaren hjälpa teamet prioritera rätt, balansera drift mot utveckling och se till att sprinten inte äts upp när det blåser.  

  

  

**Vem vi tror att du är**
-------------------------


  

Du är en person som har relevant utbildning inom IT eller arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.
  

  

Du kombinerar erfarenhet av budget- och ledarskapsansvar med god förståelse för IT-infrastruktur och säkerhet. Du har god erfarenhet av att driva förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete i en tekniktung miljö. Naturligtvis kombinerar du detta med goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift.
  

  

Utöver detta är det meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
  

* personalansvar som chef
* agila arbetssätt, sprintplanering och backlog-hantering
* molnresor och större plattformsskiften
* leverantörsstyrning och upphandlade tjänster
* ITIL och strukturerad förändringshantering
* informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhetslagen, säkerhetsskydd och närliggande regelverk
* arbete nära arkitektur och strategiskt IT-arbete.

  

Du tycker om att få ett team att fungera och får energi av att hantera flera utmaningar samtidigt. Som ledare är du tydlig och coachande, och du trivs med att leda tillsammans med andra. Du kan förklara ett tekniskt vägval på ett pedagogiskt sätt och du driver frågor självständigt även när alla förutsättningar inte är klara från början.
  

  

Du behöver inte bocka av allt på listan. Känner du igen dig i det mesta och blev nyfiken av att läsa ända hit, så sök. Vi pratar hellre med dig en gång för mycket än en gång för lite!  

  

  

**Bra att veta**
----------------


  

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placering i Västervik.
  

  

Tjänsten kan komma att säkerhetsklassas, vilket innebär att man måste vara svensk medborgare samt att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan eventuell anställning.
  

  

Behöver du hjälp att hitta bostad försöker vi hjälpa dig med det. Inflyttarservice i Västerviks kommun hjälper till med tips, information och kontakter för arbete, bostad, skolor med mera. Inflyttarservice anordnar också återkommande träffar för nyinflyttade, så att du kan lära känna nya människor och snabbare komma in i livet i Västervik.
  

  

Läs mer om vad Västerviks kommun kan erbjuda dig som anställd hos oss på www.vastervik.se/jobba-hos-oss
  

  

Välkommen med din ansökan!  

  

  

**Information**

title: Lösningsarkitekt
description:
**Startdatum:** 2026-12-01
  
  

**Slutdatum:** 2027-11-30, med option på förlängning 1+1+1 år
  
  

**Omfattning:** 100 % (40 timmar per vecka)
  
  

**Plats:** Stockholm (Kungsholmen), två fasta kontorsdagar i veckan (i perioder upp till 5), i övrigt delvis på distans
  
  

Uppdragsbeskrivning
  
  

Vi söker en erfaren lösningsarkitekt till en större kollektivtrafikaktör. Uppdraget omfattar att vidareutveckla och långsiktigt forma lösningsarkitekturen för webb, biljetter och betallösningar, med särskilt fokus på tjänster för resenärer och företagskunder.
  
  

Du arbetar nära arkitekter, produktägare och utvecklingsteam och omsätter verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar, inklusive API: er, integrationer och mikrotjänster. Teknikmiljön bygger på .Net och Azure, med höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och prestanda.
  
  

Skall-krav
  
  

Högskoleexamen inom ett datorrelaterat område, till exempel datateknik, informationsteknik eller systemvetenskap.
  
  

Minst tre (3) års dokumenterad erfarenhet av framtagande av arkitektur för frontendlösningar, inklusive integration med backend‑API: er och komponentbaserad utveckling i ramverk som React, Angular, Vue eller motsvarande.
  
  

Minst fyra (4) års dokumenterad erfarenhet i rollen som lösningsarkitekt, systemarkitekt eller motsvarande med ansvar för lösningsarkitektur och tekniska vägval. Erfarenheten ska omfatta minst två (2) uppdrag där konsulten haft ansvar för lösningsarkitektur från analys och design till driftsatt lösning.
  
  

Minst tre (3) års dokumenterad erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur för publika webbapplikationer, e‑handel, självbetjäningstjänster eller andra digitala tjänster som används av externa kunder. Interna system, intranät eller samarbetsplattformar kan inte ensamma användas för att uppfylla kravet.
  
  

Minst tre (3) års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arkitektur för API-baserade lösningar, integrationer och mikrotjänstarkitektur i produktionsmiljö.
  
  

Minst tre (3) års dokumenterad erfarenhet av att designa lösningar i molnmiljö, exempelvis Azure, AWS eller GCP.
  
  

Minst fyra (4) års dokumenterad erfarenhet av att utforma, definiera eller vägleda kring CI/CD-arkitektur för webbapplikationer, inklusive källkodshantering, automatiserade deployments och containerbaserade lösningar.
  
  

Minst två (2) års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete i lösningar med krav på autentisering, behörighetsstyrning, säker loggning och säkra integrationer.
  
  

Meriterande
  
  

Minst två (2) års dokumenterad erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur för betalningslösningar, biljettlösningar, e‑handel eller andra försäljningslösningar där externa kunder genomför köp eller transaktioner.
  
  

Minst fyra (4) års dokumenterad erfarenhet som systemutvecklare inom webb-, integrations- eller affärskritiska system.
  
  

Minst två (2) års dokumenterad erfarenhet, under de senaste sex (6) åren, av lösningsarkitektur för betalningslösningar med PCI DSS‑efterlevnad. Erfarenheten ska omfatta arkitekturella vägval och bedömningar kopplade till PCI DSS, exempelvis segmentering, dataflöden, säker lagring, loggning eller åtkomsthantering.
  
  

Språk
  
  

Arbetsspråket i teamet är svenska i både tal och skrift.

title: Senior IT-upphandlare – Lund

================================

**Om uppdraget**
----------------


Vi söker fyra erfarna IT-upphandlare till ett spännande konsultuppdrag i Lund! Här får du möjlighet att självständigt driva komplexa IT-upphandlingar och bidra till affärsmässiga, hållbara och kvalitetssäkrade inköpsprocesser inom offentlig verksamhet.


Du blir en viktig del av en inköps- och upphandlingsfunktion där du arbetar med både strategiska och operativa upphandlingar, från behovsanalys och kravställning till avtal och implementering.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**
------------------------


I rollen ansvarar du för att självständigt projektleda och genomföra kommunövergripande och verksamhetsspecifika IT-upphandlingar.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter omfattar:

* Planera, projektleda och genomföra komplexa IT-upphandlingar enligt LOU.
* Driva hela upphandlingsprocessen, från behovsanalys och kravställning till leverantörsval och avtalsskrivning.
* Upphandla IT-system, IT-relaterade produkter och tjänster.
* Säkerställa att upphandlingarna genomförs enligt gällande lagstiftning, interna riktlinjer och policys.
* Samverka med verksamheter, interna intressenter och ansvariga inom IT-kategorin.
* Stödja implementering av avtal och genomföra uppstartsmöten med leverantörer.
* Dokumentera genomförda upphandlingar och sammanställa erfarenhetsrapporter.
* Bidra till effektiva och kvalitetssäkrade upphandlingsprocesser.

**Vi söker dig som har**
------------------------

* Minst 4 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av komplexa IT-upphandlingar.
* Bred erfarenhet av att självständigt genomföra upphandlingar inom IT.
* Yrkesmässig erfarenhet av hela upphandlingsprocessen enligt lagen om offentlig upphandling (LOU).
* Kunskap om relevanta lagkrav inom IT-upphandling, exempelvis tillgänglighetsdirektivet.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera professionellt på svenska.


Du är strukturerad, affärsmässig och självgående med förmåga att driva flera upphandlingsprocesser och samarbeta med olika intressenter.

**Meriterande erfarenheter**
----------------------------

* Erfarenhet från politiskt styrda organisationer eller större verksamheter med många intressenter.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av upphandling av IT-system, programvara och IT-relaterade tjänster.
* Erfarenhet av kategoristyrt inköps- och upphandlingsarbete inom IT.

**Uppdragsinformation**
-----------------------


Plats: Lund


Arbetsmodell: Hybrid, 75 % distansarbete


Start: 1 december 2026


Slut: 31 maj 2027


Förlängning: Möjlighet till förlängning med upp till 2 månader


Omfattning: 100 %, 40 timmar per vecka


️ Språk: Svenska


Antal konsulter: 4

title: Capacity Leader Boden
description:
Vill du arbeta i en miljö där du blir en viktig länk i en samhällsviktig verksamhet? Vill du påverka och bidra till Sveriges säkerhet?



Då kan du vara den vi söker!


**FMTIS**



Försvarsmaktens telekommunikations- och informationssystemförband*,* FMTIS, säkerställer Försvarsmaktens förmåga att kommunicera och leda -dygnet runt, året om. Förbandet FMTIS har ett samlat ansvar för Försvarsmaktens tekniska ledningssystem som stödjer militära insatser till sjöss, på land och i luften – i Sverige och utomlands.


*Driftenheten* är en av tretton enheter inom FMTIS och ansvarar för att utöva funktionen som Försvarsmaktens driftoperatör, övervaka och hantera problem och incidenter samt utföra underhålls- och fjärravhjälpande åtgärder i Försvarsmaktens IT- och telekommunikationssystem.


**Produktionsavdelningen**



Till vår Produktionsavdelning vi söker en Capacity Leader. Avdelningen ansvarar för att produktionsplanera och följa upp det IT/Tele-stöd som levereras både centralt och lokalt inom Försvarsmakten. Produktionsavdelningen ansvarar också för att ta fram, beskriva och följa upp våra IT/Tele-processer, planera införanden av större förändringar samt sammanhåller införande av större förändringar i våra IT/Tele-system.


**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**



Som Capacity Leader kommer du att arbeta i en grupp tillsammans med Capacity Manager och Capacity Leaders i nära samverkan med Facilityfunktionen.



Du kommer inom gruppen att arbeta med uppgiften att planera och genomföra Capacity-relaterade uppgifter så som,


* Inplacera IT-system i befintliga Datacenter
* Planera och disponera plats i befintliga och nya rackskåpsmiljöer för IT-system
* Koordinera och stödja Datacenter-tekniker i deras dagliga arbete
* Hålla koll på resursnyttjande av lediga platser i våra IT-rumsmiljöer


Som Capacity Leader kommer du även att arbeta med Försvarsmaktens centrala IT-plattformar gällande kapacitetshantering, i detta ingår även planering inför tekniklyft av hårdvara.



Inom funktionen hanteras en hel del administrativa uppgifter som exempelvis att ansöka om besökstillstånd och behörigheter till IT-utrymmen samt hålla rackskåpsritningar uppdaterade.

Vi tror att du tycker om att ge service och att finna lösningar på problem, du är driven och van att ta egna initiativ. Du arbetar strukturerat och har god vana att upprätthålla dokumentation. title: IT Business Controller at Sweco IT
description:
**IT Business Controller at Sweco IT**
======================================


Working at Sweco IT and as a Business Controller means working in an innovative and dynamic company that is constantly changing and developing. You get the opportunity to be part of a competent and passionate team that supports and challenge each other to move forward. Learning from each other and having fun at work is important to us and we act in line with our core behaviours, approachable, committed and with recognized expertise to match.
  

  

We are now looking for a curious and business-minded Business Controller to drive insights and support the continued development of Sweco IT.


**Your role:**
  

You will be part of a controller group responsible for the financial follow-up of Sweco’s total IT costs. The IT organisation consists of approximately 315 employees, including around 30 managers with whom you will have regular contact.


In addition to traditional controller responsibilities, the role offers a broad variety of assignments involving business analysis, project controlling and strategic support. You will also support the CIO and IT leadership team with financial analyses, management reporting, presentations and decision-making material.


**Your main tasks will include:**


* Quality assurance, follow-up and budgeting of IT costs.
* Supporting IT managers with reporting, analysis and monthly follow-up against budgets and forecasts.
* Supporting the CIO and IT leadership team with presentations and decision-making material.
* Financial follow-up of internal IT projects.
* Transfer pricing and allocation of IT costs within the Group.
* Financial analysis related to suppliers, software licences and agreements.
* Business cases, investment calculations and pricing models.
* Continuous improvement and development of reporting, analysis and controlling processes, including the use of Power BI and AI tools.

The role is a full -time, permanent position, based at our Stockholm office, with opportunities for hybrid working.


**We believe that you have:**


* A relevant university degree in economics, finance or equivalent.
* A couple of years’ experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis or a similar role, preferably within an IT organisation.
* Experience working with projects and project controlling.
* Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English.
* The ability to create clear presentations and communicate financial information in an engaging and understandable way.
* Experience with BI tools such as Power BI is highly valued.
* An interest in digital development and the use of AI tools to improve analysis and ways of working.

To succeed in this role, you are communicative, structured and analytical. You enjoy collaborating with others and are confident in presenting your findings, explaining complex matters and adapting your communication to different audiences. You take initiative, work independently and have the ability to challenge and drive performance in a constructive manner.


**What we offer:**


* An inclusive, dynamic, fast-growing and friendly environment with great expertise and passion for what we do.
* A broad and varied role with opportunities to contribute to both operational and strategic matters.
* The opportunity to work closely with the CIO and IT leadership team.
* A modern working environment where you can explore and use tools such as Power BI and AI.
* Hybrid working arrangements and flexible working hours.
* Great opportunities to grow within the role and at Sweco IT.
* A competitive compensation package.

  

**Are you interested?**
  

If you want to know more about the position or have any questions, you are welcome to contact Sarah Tallmark, CFO Sweco IT, at sarah.tallmark@sweco.se. Use the link to send your application and CV today or no later than 31 December. We do not accept applications by email.
  

  

At Sweco, we strive to be a workplace characterized by diversity. We believe that more perspectives broaden our ability to continue to achieve our goals and are committed to create an inclusive environment for all employees.
  

  

We look forward to receiving your application!
  

  

Sweco plans and designs the sustainable communities and cities of the future. Together with our clients and the collective knowledge of our 23,000 architects, engineers and other experts, we co-create solutions to address urbanization, capture the power of digitalization, and make our societies more sustainable. Sweco is Europe’s leading engineering and architecture consultancy, with sales of approximately SEK 31 billion in 2024. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. www.swecogroup.com

title: IT Support Lead
description:
Are you passionate about delivering excellent IT support while helping teams grow and succeed? Do you enjoy combining hands-on technical work with leadership, coordination, and continuous improvement? We are currently looking for an IT Support Lead to join our IT team in Gothenburg, Sweden.


In this role, you will join as a senior member of the support organisation, helping coordinate daily operations, assist colleagues, and strengthen the delivery of IT services across Sweden, and the Nordic region. You will work closely with colleagues, local sites, internal stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure reliable and high-quality IT services for end users.


This is an exciting opportunity to join a business where you can make a real impact by helping shape and strengthen the support function. You will act as a senior technical resource, mentor less experienced colleagues, and help create structure, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team. In this role, you'll thrive in an engaged environment where technical expertise, teamwork, and customer focus are highly valued.

  

**What you will do as our** **IT Support Lead**

  

As an IT Support Lead, you will coordinate and support the daily IT support operation while acting as a senior point of contact for technical issues, escalations, and service improvements. While bringing seniority and technical guidance to the team, you will also remain actively involved in day-to-day support activities, handling everything from first-line support requests and user administration to more complex troubleshooting and escalated issues.


Working closely with colleagues across multiple locations, you will help ensure a consistent and high-quality support experience while contributing to the ongoing development of the support function.


This is not a formal people management role and does not include direct reports. Instead, you will serve as a senior member of the team, providing day-to-day guidance, technical coaching, and operational support to colleagues while acting as a key link between the support team and the IT Manager. You will help create structure, share knowledge, and support prioritisation across the organisation while remaining actively involved in hands-on technical work.

  

You would also:


* Coordinate and support the daily IT support operation, ensuring incidents, service requests, and escalations are prioritized and resolved effectively, while actively handling end-user support matters such as account administration, password resets, hardware requests, and other first-line support activities.
* Act as a senior technical resource and escalation point for complex end-user support issues across hardware, software, networks, and workplace technologies.
* Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to colleagues, helping strengthen technical capability and best practices within the team.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, local site contacts, external vendors, and service providers to ensure reliable IT services and support business needs.
* Support IT projects, technology implementations, and continuous improvement initiatives, while maintaining documentation, improving support processes, and enhancing the overall user experience.

  

**The skills and experience you need**

  

We are looking for someone who has:


* Several years of experience within IT Support, Service Desk, End-User Computing, Workplace Services, or IT Operations.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting end-user technologies, including Windows environments, hardware, software, workplace services, and general IT infrastructure.
* Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with experience managing incidents, service requests, and escalations in a structured support environment.
* A good understanding of networking concepts and infrastructure-related troubleshooting, with the ability to support colleagues and act as a technical escalation point when needed.
* Professional proficiency in English. Knowledge of a Nordic language, particularly Swedish or Norwegian, is highly valued as you will support users across Sweden and Norway.

  

You are a customer-focused and proactive IT professional who enjoys helping others succeed. Rather than managing people directly, you act as a confident and experienced colleague who is comfortable sharing knowledge, coaching team members, and providing guidance in day-to-day support activities.

  

You thrive in a hands-on environment where priorities can shift quickly and where no two days are the same. You enjoy taking ownership, solving problems, and bringing structure to complex situations while maintaining a high level of service.

  

Experience working with external vendors and service providers, supporting multi-site environments, and contributing to IT projects or service improvements would be beneficial. Knowledge of ITIL principles or service management processes is also considered an advantage.

  

Most importantly, you are a technically strong support professional who enjoys collaborating with others, sharing expertise, and helping create a reliable and efficient IT support function that delivers an excellent user experience.

  

**What we offer**

  

We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:


* Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills.
* A competitive salary
* Stable employment in a friendly international atmosphere

  

**We review applications regularly, so don't wait.**

  

We are building diverse and inclusive teams and encourage applications from all who can envision themselves working with us. Just set up your profile and apply here


To ensure that your personal information is secure, we do not review any applications sent via email or post.


If you have any questions about the role or the process, please send an email to Khalil Kabakibi, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at Khalil.kabakibi@assaabloy.com.

title: IT-tekniker/Ingenjör -Applikationsspecialist IT till Medicinsk Teknik
description:
**Vill du arbeta med tekniskt avancerade och verksamhetskritiska IT-system som har direkt betydelse för vårdens kvalitet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet? Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk felsökning, applikationsdrift, systemförvaltning och utveckling där IT, medicinsk teknik och vårdens vardag möts.**

**Medicinsk Teknik Hallan****d (MTH) söker en Applikationsspecialist IT till MTH Informationssystem. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering i Halmstad alternativt Varberg.**

**Om tjänsten**
---------------


Som Applikationsspecialist IT arbetar du med verksamhetskritiska IT-system kopplade till medicinteknisk utrustning och vårdnära processer. Du är en teknisk länk mellan vårdverksamheten, medicintekniska ingenjörer, Region Hallands IT- och digitaliseringsverksamhet och leverantörer.


Du arbetar med hela den tekniska kedjan, från klient och applikation till integrationer, nätverk, servrar, databaser, behörigheter och IT-säkerhet. Rollen omfattar både löpande felsökning och förvaltning samt uppgraderingar, förändringar och utveckling.


Avdelningen MTH Informationssystem har cirka 15 medarbetare i Halmstad och Varberg. Du ingår i teamet som hanterar radiologiska bilder och tillhörande applikationer. Området är verksamhetskritiskt, med höga tillgänglighetskrav och ständig digital utveckling, bland annat inom AI.

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

* förvalta och vidareutveckla medicintekniska IT-system
* felsöka incidenter i hela den tekniska kedjan, från utrustning och klient till nätverk, servrar och databaser
* arbeta med applikationsdrift, systemadministration, behörigheter, IT-säkerhet och teknisk dokumentation
* planera och genomföra uppgraderingar, servicefönster och förebyggande underhåll
* delta i upphandlingar, implementationer, systembyten och andra projekt
* ta fram tekniska krav och samverka med leverantörer vid installation och driftsättning

**Om oss**
----------


Medicinsk Teknik Halland (MTH) stödjer och utvecklar hälso- och sjukvården i Region Halland inom medicinsk teknik, medicintekniska informationssystem, sjukhusfysik och vårdens tekniska infrastruktur.


Vi är drygt 80 medarbetare med verksamhet främst i Halmstad, Varberg och Kungsbacka. Vi arbetar nära vården och strävar efter att vara nära, proaktiva och professionella.

**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Krav**

* IT- eller ingenjörsutbildning eller motsvarande kompetens
* erfarenhet av IT-arbete i en medelstor eller större organisation
* god förståelse för komplexa IT-miljöer och felsökning i klient- och servermiljö
* kunskaper om Windows Server, Windows 11 och Microsofts servertjänster
* kunskaper om nätverk, systemintegrationer och databaser
* grundläggande kunskaper inom AD, programmering och IT-säkerhet
* god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift samt föra dialog med leverantörer på engelska
* B-körkort

**Meriterande erfarenheter**

* medicintekniska IT-system eller vård-IT
* systemförvaltning och livscykelhantering
* test, validering, dokumentation och strukturerat förbättringsarbete, exempelvis ITIL
* upphandling av system och utrustning
* erfarenhet av projekt eller förändringsarbete

### **Personliga egenskaper**


Du arbetar strukturerat, analytiskt och lösningsorienterat och tar ansvar för helheten. Du trivs i gränslandet mellan teknik och verksamhet och kan förklara tekniska frågor på ett begripligt sätt. Dokumentation, struktur och ordning är en naturlig del av ditt arbetssätt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**


Intervjuer på plats i Halmstad är planerade till vecka 51.

### **Vårt erbjudande**


För oss är det viktigt att du ska trivas och utvecklas i ditt arbete.  

Läs mer om vad Region Halland kan erbjuda dig som medarbetare här.

**Om Hallands sjukhus**  

Vår målsättning är att erbjuda Sveriges bästa akut- och specialistsjukvård. På Hallands sjukhus arbetar närmare 4 000 personer, inom fler än 100 olika professioner. title: Senior Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
**Why Mozilla?**



Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**About the OS Integration team:**



The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support.


**About the role:**



As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will be focused on Firefox on Windows, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments and especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.


**What you’ll do:**


* Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
* Contribute to new features and improvements.
* Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
* Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
* Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
* Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
* Interact with teams throughout the organization.


**What you’ll bring:**


* 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
* Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++ (will consider experience with C++ on macOS or Linux).
* Strong knowledge of C, C++, and assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.
* Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
* Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
* Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
* Commitment to our values:
* + Welcoming differences
	+ Being relationship-minded
	+ Practicing responsible participation
	+ Having grit

**Bonus Points for experience with:**


* Enterprise DLP development or deployment
* Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects


**What you’ll get:**


* Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
* Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
* Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
* Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
* One-time home office stipend
* Annual professional development budget
* Considerable paid parental leave
* Employee referral bonus program
* Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)


**About Mozilla**



Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.


**Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**



Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.



We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
At Electrolux Professional Group we hire to meet needs beyond tomorrow!


UNLOCK YOUR POTENTIAL


At Electrolux Professional Group, we believe potential powers progress. We’re not searching for perfection—we’re looking for people with the right mindset. If you're curious, resilient, and ready to grow, you'll find the space to lead, innovate, and together with us Meet the needs beyond tomorrow. Read more about us here: https://www.electroluxprofessionalgroup.com/en/join-us/  

  



**SOFTWARE TEST ENGENEER**

At Electrolux Professional, we're looking for three Software Test Engineers to join our R&D Lab in Ljungby and help shape the next generation of connected professional laundry solutions.


In this role, you'll ensure that our software delivers the quality, reliability, and performance our customers depend on every day. Working closely with developers and cross-functional engineering teams, you'll play a key role in validating features, identifying improvements, and driving continuous quality throughout the development process.


If you're passionate about testing, problem-solving, and turning complex technical challenges into robust solutions, then this is an opportunity where you can make a real impact!  

  



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING


* Perform software testing and validation activities.
* Test new software releases to ensure functionality, stability, and compliance with requirements.
* Develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test procedures.
* Identify, document, and track software defects.
* Collaborate closely with software developers to investigate and resolve issues.
* Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality is not affected by software changes.
* Support Software Quality Assurance (SQA) processes and continuous improvement activities.
Report test results, issues, and validation status to the team.  
* 

WHAT’S NEEDED FOR YOU TO THRIVE


* Good understanding of software testing methodologies and SQA principles.
* Experience in functional testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Ability to analyze software requirements and translate them into test cases.
* Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with bug-tracking and test-management tools (e.g., Jira).
* Good communication skills and ability to work closely with software developers.
* Ability to work independently and as part of an international team.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering or relevant field
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.  
* 

Advantage:


* Software skills (Python, C, C# or equivalent)
Basic electronic skills (hardware)  
* 

*To be eligible for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in Sweden.*  



OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES
  

Be Customer Obsessed. Build Trust. Be Bold. Act Sustainably. We’re building it every day — and we’d love your help.
  

  

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU


Trust, ownership, and the opportunity to grow! Be part of a company grounded in customer focus, sustainability leadership, innovation, and social impact.
  

We aim to Meet Needs Beyond Tomorrow!
  

  

Some of our benefits:


* Occupational pension plan
* Collective agreement
* Lunch benefits
* Massage at the office at discounted price
* Wellness allowance
* Beniflex (discounts on purchases)
* Parental leave benefits etc.

title: MES Solution Architect
description:
**Join us in shaping the future of digital manufacturing at Nobia Park!**


At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.


We are now looking for a **MES Solution Architect** to play a key role in designing, developing, and evolving the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions that support our production and logistics operations.


This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.

**Where we are right now**


Nobia is in one of the most exciting phases in its history. As part of our transformation journey, we are continuously developing the digital capabilities that support our highly automated production environment at Nobia Park in Jönköping.


As production volumes continue to increase and new capabilities are introduced, the need for scalable, integrated and business-driven MES solutions becomes even more important. We are therefore strengthening our MES organization and expanding our internal capability to design, develop, and support solutions that create value across manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, and supply chain operations.

**About the role**


As a **MES Solution Architect**, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting business-critical MES solutions that enable efficient and reliable operations across the factory.


Acting as the bridge between business processes and technical execution, you will ensure that solutions are scalable, integrated, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural standards.


The role combines solution architecture, stakeholder collaboration, process development, and continuous improvement in a highly automated manufacturing environment.

**Your responsibilities**

* Translate business requirements into scalable and effective MES solutions, ensuring alignment with both operational needs and architectural standards.
* Design and support integrations between MES, SAP S/4HANA, production equipment, and other business-critical systems.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, MES Solution Engineers, and external partners throughout the design, development, testing, and implementation lifecycle.
* Contribute to the evolution of MES architecture, development standards, governance, and future ways of working.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, support incident management, and contribute to increased operational efficiency, system stability, and production performance.
**Location:** Nobia Park, Jönköping. This is an on-site position.

**Who you are**


To succeed in this role, you are a proactive and collaborative professional who enjoys working where manufacturing processes and technology meet.


You have the ability to understand operational needs and translate them into sustainable system solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, engaging with stakeholders across different functions, and driving improvements that create measurable business value.


You are comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and thrive in an environment where technology plays a critical role in operational success.

**Most importantly,** you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where your expertise will help shape the digital manufacturing landscape of one of Europe's most advanced production facilities.

**We believe you bring**

* 5+ years of experience working with MES solutions in manufacturing environments, preferably within highly automated production facilities.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, MES architecture, and system integrations across MES, ERP (preferably SAP S/4HANA), machines and shop floor technologies.
* Experience with C#, T-SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, relational databases, and industrial communication standards such as OPC UA.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluency in Swedish and English.
**It is highly desirable if you have**

* Experience with Insight2020.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
**About Nobia**


Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist and part of everyday life for millions of people, with the kitchen playing an increasingly important role in modern homes. The Group consists of eighteen strong brands, including Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form.


At Nobia, you will have the opportunity to be part of a modern manufacturing environment where you can make a real impact. We offer a dynamic workplace with excellent opportunities for both personal and professional growth, giving you the chance to influence the way we work and the results we achieve. Our culture is built on safety, collaboration, and a continuous drive for improvement.


Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park.

**Want to be a part of our journey?**


Then we would like to receive your application later than **December 13.**


We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match.


As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening may be conducted as part of the recruitment process. A six-month probationary period can be applied.


For questions regarding the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com

*We look forward to welcoming you to our team!*

title: Avdelningschef – Systemförvaltningsenheten, FMTIS
description:
*Vill du vara med och bygga vår verksamhet?*



Vi söker en trygg ledare och medspelare som är redo att anta utmaningen att fortsätta utveckla och förstärka vår förmåga att tillhandahålla säkra, robusta, tillförlitliga och tillgängliga IT-stöd som bidrar till Sveriges försvarsförmåga.


**Om Systemförvaltningsenheten**

title: Systems and Network Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Want to be part of transforming road freight? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, autonomous and electric technologies. We build the technology that hauls freight efficiently, and we put it to work for the world's leading manufacturers, retailers, logistics providers and defense organizations, all working toward a future where moving goods costs less for our customers, and less for the planet.


Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a U.S. public road. In June 2026, Einride became a publicly listed company on Nasdaq, a milestone that reflects a decade of turning what once looked like science fiction into everyday reality. Today, our technology moves freight across North America, Europe, and the Middle East for some of the world's biggest shippers.

### **You will:**


In this role, you will manage and automate our core business applications—including Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, and device management—while overseeing our GCP infrastructure (primarily via Terraform), limited on-prem servers, and Meraki/Linux-based VPN networks. You will also serve as a technical escalation point for advanced user support and maintain clear documentation for both end users and the IT team.

* Manage GCP and on-prem infrastructure, and troubleshoot Meraki networks (office and charging stations) alongside our Linux-based VPN.
* Administer core business tools and build custom integrations and automations between them.
* Stockholm Office Expansion: Partner with the IT Manager to spec technical requirements and execute the full setup of the new Stockholm office, from networking to conference room AV.
* Act as an advanced escalation point across Linux, macOS, and Windows (including backup coverage for the Stockholm IT technician) and write internal and end-user documentation.

### **We expect you to:**


Be a self-directed problem-solver who is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving environment and genuinely enjoys helping people. You don’t need to tick every box—we are happy to train you on specific tools—as long as you are fluent in English, bring strong communication skills, and want to move away from manual GUI workflows toward structured configuration.

* Solid command-line skills, including SSH, permissions, logs, and package management.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, Wi-Fi), with hands-on exposure to Meraki or similar managed network gear.
* Experience with Terraform (or similar IaC tools) and cloud platforms like GCP, AWS, or Azure is a major plus.
* Ideally, you have some coding experience (e.g., Python or Go) and have administered device management tools (such as Intune or Jamf) or on-prem servers and hypervisors (like Proxmox or vSphere).
* The ability to clearly explain technical concepts in both spoken and written English.


This is a full-time role based in Stockholm, with occasional travel to Einride sites across Sweden. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.


Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest.

**Company Description**
-----------------------

  

Born autonomous. Born electric.


Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.


We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

title: Testledare
description:
Som Testledare hos oss hjälper du kunder att säkerställa kvalitet i digitala lösningar som används varje dag. Du arbetar i skärningspunkten mellan verksamhet, test och utveckling och bidrar till att skapa lösningar som fungerar i praktiken och håller över tid.


Du får vara med genom hela utvecklingsresan, från att förstå verksamhetens behov till att planera och leda testarbetet, kvalitetssäkra leveranser och säkerställa att rätt lösning når användaren. Tillsammans med kunder, verksamhet och utvecklingsteam skapar du förutsättningar för stabila, välfungerande och hållbara lösningar.

#### **Är du den vi söker?**


Vi tror att du trivs i uppdrag där du får:

* Planera, koordinera och leda testarbete i utvecklingsprojekt
* Säkerställa kvalitet genom hela utvecklingsprocessen
* Omsätta verksamhetskrav till testbara lösningar
* Arbeta nära verksamhet, utvecklingsteam och andra intressenter
* Bidra till förbättrade arbetssätt inom test, kvalitet och kravhantering
* Följa upp testresultat och hantera risker genom hela leveransen


Du gillar att skapa tydlighet i komplexa sammanhang och att samarbeta med olika kompetenser för att driva kvalitet framåt. Vi söker dig som vill ta en aktiv roll i att skapa kvalitet hos våra kunder och som uppskattar att arbeta nära både verksamhet och utveckling.


Du behöver inte vara expert på allt. Det viktiga är att du vill bidra med din erfarenhet, fortsätta utvecklas och dela kunskap med andra.

#### **Vad du kan arbeta med hos oss**


Arbetsuppgifterna kan se olika ut beroende på kund, uppdrag och din profil. Du kan till exempel få arbeta med:

##### **Testledning och kvalitetssäkring**

* Ta fram teststrategier, testplaner och testfall
* Leda och koordinera testaktiviteter
* Följa upp testresultat och identifiera risker
* Säkerställa kvalitet i leveranser genom hela utvecklingsprocessen

##### **Kravhantering och verksamhetsnära arbete**

* Arbeta med kravanalys och kravhantering
* Säkerställa att krav är tydliga, spårbara och testbara
* Vara länken mellan verksamhet, test och utveckling
* Delta i workshops och kravarbete tillsammans med kunder

##### **Testautomatisering**

* Arbeta med och utveckla automatiserade tester
* Bidra till effektiva testprocesser och högre kvalitet i leveranser
* Stötta team i arbetet med kontinuerlig kvalitetssäkring
* Bidra till att utveckla arbetssätt och verktyg inom testområdet

#### **Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av att**

* Leda eller bidra i test- och kvalitetssäkringsarbete inom systemutveckling
* Planera och genomföra systemtestning
* Arbeta med kravanalys och kravhantering
* Skapa tydlighet mellan verksamhet, test och utveckling
* Arbeta i agila team, exempelvis enligt Scrum
* Använda testautomatisering som en del av kvalitetssäkringsarbetet
* God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

#### **Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av**

* Explorativ testning
* Integrationstester
* API-testning
* Azure DevOps, Jira eller liknande verktyg
* CI/CD-flöden
* Testdokumentation
* Kravledning eller verksamhetsanalys
* Arbetat med SQL och databaser
* Arbete i komplexa systemmiljöer med många integrationer

#### **Uppdrag där du gör skillnad och får utvecklas**


Hos oss hamnar du i uppdrag som är:

* affärs- och verksamhetskritiska där din kompetens behövs på riktigt
* långsiktiga med tid att bygga hållbara lösningar
* utvecklande där du får växa genom nya typer av tekniska och verksamhetsmässiga utmaningar
* stabila med team som står stadigt och kunder som litar på oss


Vi matchar inte konsulter slumpmässigt. Vi matchar rätt personer med rätt uppdrag.

#### **Vi satsar på dig**


Omegapoint är byggt för lärande. Här får du:

* kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling
* gemenskap och kunskapsdelning genom interna forum, kompetensdagar och konferenser
* möjlighet att certifiera dig, föreläsa och driva initiativ
* stöd från kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sina erfarenheter
* en kultur där vi är både vassa och snälla


Tillsammans bygger vi säkra digitala lösningar som skapar långsiktigt värde.

#### **Om oss**

title: NIRA Engineering Summer Internship 2027
description:
**Apply here: NIRA Summer Internship 2027 application**


Want to turn your engineering knowledge into real-world solutions?


At NIRA Dynamics, we develop innovative software solutions that make vehicles safer, smarter, and more efficient. Our technology is used in millions of vehicles worldwide, combining embedded software, data analysis, and cloud-based services to solve real challenges in the automotive industry.


We're looking for curious and motivated engineering students to join our team in Linköping for the 2027 NIRA Engineering Summer Internship.

**About the Internship**


Our summer internship is an opportunity to experience what engineering looks like beyond the classroom.


You'll work alongside experienced engineers on meaningful projects, applying your knowledge while learning new technologies, development practices, and approaches to problem-solving.


Depending on your interests and background, your project may involve:

* **Embedded software and vehicle systems**  

Developing and testing software for automotive applications.
* **Cloud and data engineering**  

Building services, processing vehicle data, and developing data-driven solutions.
* **Software and web development**  

Creating applications, tools, and interfaces that support our products and engineering teams.
* **AI and modern development workflows**  

Exploring how AI-assisted development, automation, and emerging technologies can improve engineering processes.


We work with technologies such as C, C++, Python, MATLAB, React, Java, Kubernetes, and Jenkins, among others. The specific tools and technologies will depend on your project.


We also encourage the thoughtful use of modern AI development tools, combining new capabilities with sound engineering principles, testing, and critical thinking.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real engineering challenges**  

Work on meaningful projects with practical applications and the opportunity to make a lasting contribution.
* **Mentorship and collaboration**  

Learn from experienced engineers who will support and challenge you throughout the summer.
* **Modern development practices**  

Gain hands-on experience with professional development workflows, including code reviews, testing, automation, and AI-assisted engineering.
* **Room to explore**  

Work on a project that aligns with your background, interests, and ambitions.
* **A welcoming team**  

Become part of a collaborative engineering environment where sharing ideas and asking questions are encouraged.

**Who Are We Looking For?**


We're looking for students who enjoy solving problems, exploring technologies, and turning ideas into working solutions.


Ideally, you:

* Are pursuing a BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Applied Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Have a genuine interest in software development, engineering, or data-driven technologies.
* Enjoy tackling unfamiliar challenges and taking initiative.
* Can work independently while collaborating and communicating effectively with others.
* Are comfortable communicating in English, both written and spoken.


You don't need to know every technology we use. We value curiosity, analytical thinking, practical problem-solving, and a willingness to learn. Experience with AI-assisted development, personal software projects, or other hands-on engineering activities is welcome but not required.

**Application Process**


Our internships take place on-site at our Linköping office and are aimed at students in their third to fifth year of university studies in Sweden. International students are welcome to apply. However, applicants must already have the legal right to work in Sweden for the duration of the internship.


We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply early.


Join us for a summer of engineering, learning, and building technology that makes a difference.

**Apply here: NIRA Summer Internship 2027 application**

Utvecklare

-------------------

Vi tror att du är nyfiken på teknik och har en god teknisk förståelse som hjälper dig att snabbt sätta dig in i kundlösningar, system och leveransflöden. Du drivs av att skapa värde för kunden genom professionella och kvalitativa leveranser och är en god kommunikatör med ett starkt kund- och servicetänk.

Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som delar kunskap, samarbetar nära kollegor och bidrar till teamets gemensamma framgång och en positiv teamkultur.

title: Business Controller
description:
**Challenge the Impossible**

**About Beyond Gravity**


Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1'900 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and produce solutions for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2025, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 402 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com.

  

**Our Crew**

  

The Finance team in Linköping plays a key role in supporting business performance in the business unit. We work closely with Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain and Business Unit leadership to provide financial insights that drive informed decision-making and long-term business success. You will partner with stakeholders across functions, helping to improve profitability, operational efficiency, and working capital performance while supporting some of the world's most advanced space projects.

  

**Your Mission**

  

We are currently looking for a Business Controller who will act as a trusted business partner to the Operations manager, providing financial insights and analytical support to drive operational and financial performance across the business unit together with the Business Unit Controller.

  

Your main tasks include:


* Analyze production costs, project profitability, and cash flow drivers to identify risks and opportunities, and track corrective actions through to completion.
* Prepare management presentations and business commentary for monthly reviews, forecasts, and leadership meetings.
* Validate standard costs, weighted-average pricing, and project cost assumptions together with Operations and Supply Chain to ensure reliable inventory valuation and pricing decisions.
* Own the operational budgeting, forecasting, and business planning processes, ensuring alignment with business objectives and management expectations.
* Manage and coordinate CAPEX-related activities, including business cases and investment follow-ups together with the Business Unit Controller.
* Coordinate operational audit activities, support documentation requirements, and follow up on agreed improvement actions.
  
**Your Story**

  

Must have:

  

* University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 5–7 years of experience in controlling, financial analysis, or business finance, preferably within an international industrial environment.
* Experience working in project-based businesses with a strong understanding of project financials and profitability drivers.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights.
* High proficiency in digital tools and a genuine interest in process optimization and continuous improvement.
* Solid understanding of financial processes and experience working with ERP systems such as SAP.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both operational teams and senior management.
* You take ownership from start to finish, turning plans into action, overcoming obstacles, and following through until results are delivered.
* Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
  
Nice to have:

  

* Experience working with SAP S/4HANA, preferably in a cloud-based environment.
* Experience from aerospace, aviation, defense, or other high-technology industries.
* Experience working directly with senior leadership teams and executive stakeholders.
* Experience from a manufacturing or production environment, including production controlling.
* Knowledge of inventory valuation, standard costing, and working capital management.
* Experience working in international organizations and cross-functional teams.
  
**Why Beyond Gravity?**

  

* To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
* You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
* We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with.
* Wellness allowance via the benefits portal Epassi.
  

**Are you ready for lift-off?**

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.  



For questions regarding the position, please contact: Àsdís Vidarsdóttir | Asdis.Vidarsdottir@beyondgravity.com  

  



For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: Breno Silva | breno.silva@beyondgravity.com

  

*Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.*

*Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.*
