title: Night Receptionist, Scandic Frimurarehotellet, deltid 87,5%
description:
Ansök nu
* Urval sker löpande
* Linköping
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


Endast 150 meter från Linköpings centralstation ligger Scandic Frimurarehotellet – hotellet där tradition och framtid möts. Beläget strax intill Domkyrkan i en av Linköpings vackraste byggnader ligger vårt moderna och avslappnade hotell med anor från 1912. Hotellet är Östergötlands största och arrangerar allt från möten och bröllop till stora banketter.


Vi som jobbar här är närmare hundra medarbetare och vi har vårt ursprung från ungefär hela världen, precis som våra gäster. Att vi är ett stort hotell och att de tre Scandic hotellen i Linköping har gemensam ledning medför mycket goda utvecklingsmöjligheter för våra medarbetare.


**Nu söker vi en Night Receptionist till Scandic Frimurarehotellet.**


Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.


Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!


Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**


Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Eftersom hotellet har öppet dygnet runt söker vi dig som trivs med att arbeta natt och känner dig bekväm med att ta ansvar under dygnets sena timmar.


**Vem är du?**


För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.


Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid. Arbetstiden är 7 dagar varannan vecka, torsdag till torsdag.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.


Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!


Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
==============================================

  

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.


We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About the Role**
------------------


You like understanding how software behaves in production. When a service is slow or a failure keeps coming back, you want to trace the cause, change the system, and check that the fix holds up.


At Tandem, you’ll improve the reliability of the services clinicians use every day. You’ll write code, build tests and tooling, and work with service owners to make failures easier to find and recover from. Your work will cover how services behave under load, how they handle problems in their dependencies, and what engineers can see when something goes wrong.


You might investigate a slow workflow, build a realistic load test, or change an alert that keeps paging without giving anyone useful information. You’ll take improvements from investigation through implementation and production, working alongside product, platform, and infrastructure engineers.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Investigate failures and performance problems across services, queues, databases, and external dependencies, then implement fixes with the teams that own them.
* Improve metrics, logs, and tracing so engineers can understand what users experience and locate the cause of a problem.
* Build dashboards and actionable alerts around service objectives, and tune alerts that create noise without helping responders.
* Write load and recovery tests to find capacity limits and check how services behave when dependencies slow down or fail.
* Automate recurring operational tasks and improve runbooks so response relies less on manual steps or individual knowledge.
* Take part in incident response with service owners, and follow through on fixes and tests that prevent repeat failures.
* Work with CI/CD engineers on release-health checks that help teams spot regressions and decide whether to continue or roll back a rollout.
* Measure whether changes improve service behaviour and reduce recurring operational work.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Experience building or operating production services and improving how they perform and recover from failures.
* Strong software engineering skills and the ability to write maintainable code, test it, and follow changes through to production.
* Experience using metrics, logs, and traces to investigate problems across several components.
* An understanding of distributed-system failure modes, including timeouts, retries, concurrency, and resource limits.
* The ability to explain what you know during an incident, make uncertainty clear, and work through a problem with other engineers.
* Judgement about which improvements will help most, and the persistence to carry them through with the teams involved.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience with service objectives, error budgets, or improving alert quality.
* Experience with load testing, failure testing, or automating recovery.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud platforms, PostgreSQL, or services that depend on external AI or speech providers.
* Experience in healthcare or another environment where data protection and availability are central to the work.

**Location**
------------


We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.

  

**How to Apply**
----------------


We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.


Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* Technical interviews with one of our engineers
* Interview with the Platform Team Lead
* System Design Interview at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch and a Product focused System Design interview to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
* Follow-up interview with our CTO & Co-Founder

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*

**Culture at Tandem**
=====================

  

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.


Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.


Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.


We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.  

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Senior Product Manager, Nexus
description:
**Senior Product Manager, Nexus**
=================================

**Why this role exists**
------------------------


AI agents can only be trusted if they run on a governed source: knowledge that is validated, approved, permission-aware, and traced back to where every claim came from.


Paligo is building it. We are expanding from a CCMS trusted by documentation teams worldwide into Governed Context Infrastructure: that governed source, for agents and humans alike.


Our 2027 goal is simple: governed context infrastructure in customers' hands. You will be the person who puts it there.

**What you will own**
---------------------


You will lead product for the Nexus family, the heart of that platform:

* **Neo**, the governance harness. Brings in content from wherever it lives (our CCMS, SharePoint, Confluence, Google Drive), validates it against rules people define, and lets agents curate while a human makes the final call.
* **Anchor**, the grounding infrastructure. Serves governed knowledge to AI agents and assistants with permission-aware access, and traces every claim to its source.
* **Nexus Answers and Portal**, where people and agents use that knowledge: chat, Slack, MCP, APIs and a branded portal.


One pipeline, one platform. Your job is to make it feel that way to every customer.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Set the strategy and one roadmap across Neo, Anchor, Answers and Portal
* Design the platform for builders: APIs, MCP and connectors that teams use to run their own agents on governed knowledge
* Learn from a new set of buyers: CTOs, CIOs, and quality and compliance leaders in regulated industries
* Take products from lighthouse customers to general availability, with usage-based pricing
* Make security, permissions and deployment choice (cloud or on-prem) part of the product from day one
* Keep the team focused on our ideal customers, and say no to the rest

**What you might bring**
------------------------

* Several years in product management, including platform, data, infrastructure or developer products
* Hands-on curiosity about AI: retrieval, agents, evaluation, and where they go wrong
* Comfort discussing architecture with engineers and business value with a CIO
* Experience bringing new B2B products to market, ideally with enterprise or regulated customers
* Clear writing, and steady judgment when the path is not yet mapped Knowledge graphs, data governance or structured content are a bonus, not a requirement.

**Not ticking every box?** Many great candidates, especially women and people from underrepresented groups, hold back unless they meet every point. Please don't. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you.

**Working with us**
-------------------

* A senior role reporting to the CTO, working closely with engineering, design and go-to-market
* Hybrid, based at our office in Solna, Stockholm
* A small team where your work is visible and your voice shapes the product


Paligo is an equal-opportunity employer. We want a team that reflects the customers and the world we build for, and we welcome people of every gender, background, age, ability and path into tech. Need an adjustment in the hiring process? Tell us and we will make it happen.


At Paligo, every recruitment includes reference checks and a background check. These are done in the final stage of the process, with your consent, and we will let you know exactly what they include before we start. All information is handled confidentially and in line with GDPR.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
Help teams make confident security decisions in the technology behind connected mobility. As a Senior Security Architect at WirelessCar, you’ll shape how we build secure services, work through complex challenges with experienced colleagues and turn security requirements into solutions that work in practice.

#### **About WirelessCar**


WirelessCar partners with vehicle manufacturers to build the connected services that make mobility smarter, easier and safer for everyone. Since 1999, we have connected the vehicle on the road with the digital world around it. Today we support nearly 20 million connected vehicles in over 100 markets. We are headquartered in Sweden, with offices in China, Germany, India, Japan and the US.  

  

We work side by side with OEMs and ecosystem partners to connect, orchestrate, operate and continuously evolve software-defined mobility worldwide. Our portfolio spans connectivity, insights, charging and assistance throughout the vehicle lifecycle, helping our customers turn complexity into competitiveness. Our customers include Jaguar Land Rover, Subaru, Volkswagen and Volvo Cars.

#### **About the Role**


Security architecture at WirelessCar connects technical decisions with the needs of our business, customers and development teams. We’re looking for a Senior Security Architect who can bring these perspectives together and help teams build security into their solutions from the start.


We’re looking for someone with strong expertise in application security, AWS and Kubernetes-based services cloud security, together with a practical understanding of DevSecOps.


You’ll take responsibility for security architecture across multiple systems, platforms or deliveries. Working closely with fellow Security Architects, Solution Architects, DevOps engineers, Service lead and Quality Assurance specialist, you’ll guide decisions from early design through implementation and ongoing improvements.


Your work will include:

* Reviewing application and cloud architectures from security perspective, particularly solutions running on AWS and Kubernetes-based services.
* Strengthening secure development and DevSecOps practices across team including advising on Git workflows, branch protection and secure CI/CD pipelines.
* Providing guidance on authentication and authorization, secrets management, encryption and secure service-to-service communication.
* Supporting vulnerability management, secure operations and the continuous improvement of security controls.
* Helping multiple DevOps teams understand threats, assess risks and choose practical security controls.
* Reviewing designs and working through decisions where security, cost, complexity and delivery needs meet.
* Developing shared patterns and guidance that make secure solutions easier to build and maintain.


You’ll stay close enough to delivery to understand how your recommendations work in practice. You’ll also contribute to customer discussions, explain architectural choices and explore new technologies where they could make a meaningful difference.


The role includes occasional travel depending on delivery and customer needs.

#### **Your Impact**

* **Shape secure application and cloud architectures** – Define, maintain and approve security architecture across your scope, aligned with WirelessCar’s security strategy and architectural principles.
* **Strengthen AWS and Kubernetes-based services security** – Help teams design and operate secure environments, including appropriate identity, access, network, logging, monitoring, encryption and resilience controls.
* **Enable DevSecOps** – Improve Git practices, branch protection, CI/CD security and the integration of automated security controls into delivery pipelines.
* **Bring security into early decisions** – Embed security and privacy considerations throughout the development lifecycle.
* **Address risks with clear actions** – Lead threat modelling and architectural assessments, helping teams prioritise improvements and follow them through.
* **Improve application security fundamentals** – Guide teams on authentication and authorization, secrets management, encryption, secure coding and protection of sensitive data.
* **Connect architecture with vulnerability management and operations** – Ensure vulnerabilities, security findings and operational risks are understood, prioritized and addressed sustainably.
* **Make secure design more consistent** – Improve reusable patterns, standards and design review practices across systems and platforms.
* **Connect architecture with operations** – Work with GRC and security operations colleagues to ensure designs address real risks and remain practical to operate.
* **Build understanding and confidence** – Explain security decisions and trade-offs to technical teams, business stakeholders and customers.
* **Help others develop** – Coach engineers and less experienced architects, sharing knowledge and strengthening security architecture across WirelessCar.

#### **What We're Looking For**


You combine deep technical knowledge with a practical understanding of how software and services are delivered. You can look beyond an individual component, recognise how decisions affect the wider solution and help people find a sound way forward. You also understand how security is implemented across the full lifecycle: from application design and coding through source control, CI/CD, cloud deployment, vulnerability management and secure operations.


You take ownership, ask thoughtful questions and listen to different perspectives. You’re comfortable challenging a design, explaining your reasoning and working with others to resolve the issue. You understand that good security architecture needs both clear direction and collaboration.

#### **You’ll bring**

* Substantial experience designing and governing secure applications, cloud platforms and distributed systems, typically gained through around 8–12 years of relevant work.
* Strong practical experience with AWS and Kubernetes-based services security architecture and cloud security controls.
* A solid understanding of software development and DevSecOps practices, including Git, branching strategies, branch protection and secure CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience integrating security controls and automated security testing into development and delivery workflows.
* Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, identity and access management, secrets management and encryption.
* Deep expertise in security architecture across complex systems, with the ability to connect design decisions to business needs, risk and delivery constraints.
* Experience leading threat modelling, architectural risk assessments and security design reviews.
* Experience translating security, privacy, regulatory and contractual requirements into practical designs, controls and guidance.
* Experience with vulnerability management, security findings, secure development and operations including security incident response.
* Experience developing architecture standards, reusable patterns and review processes that teams can apply consistently.
* The ability to explain complex topics clearly, guide decisions across teams and coach others.
* The ability to balance security, cost, complexity, usability and delivery needs when making technical recommendations.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Clear communication in English, both written and spoken.

#### **It would be a plus if you have**

* Experience in automotive, connected vehicles or other complex environments with demanding security requirements.
* Experience applying relevant standards and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155 or NIST frameworks.
* Experience supporting customer discussions, RFIs or RFQs from a security architecture perspective.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, container security, Kubernetes or serverless architectures.
* Relevant certifications, such as CISSP, CSSLP, SABSA, CCSP or cloud security certifications.

#### **Why WirelessCar?**


At WirelessCar, you’ll have the trust and freedom to take ownership, share ideas and make an impact. We value collaboration, curiosity and different perspectives, and believe people do their best work when they have room to grow.


When you join WirelessCar, you can expect:

* **Freedom to make an impact –** Take ownership and help shape what we do.
* **Collaboration across borders –** Work with talented people and perspectives from around the world.
* **Room to grow –** Develop your skills, explore new areas and learn along the way.
* **Space for ideas –** Challenge the way we work and turn ideas into action.
* **A supportive environment –** We care about each other and create space to contribute, grow and do your best work.
* **At WirelessCar, we want you to enjoy what you do, feel proud of what you contribute and have fun along the way.**

#### **What We Offer**

* **Health & wellbeing** – Wellness contribution and initiatives that support your health and wellbeing.
* **Work-life balance** – Generous holiday, additional time off through our working time reduction, and parental leave compensation.
* **Financial benefits** – Competitive pension and insurance benefits, bonus and profit-sharing opportunities.
* **Technology & mobility** – Flexible options for technology, as well as company car and bike leasing.
* **A great everyday experience** – Weekly breakfasts and opportunities to connect and spend time with colleagues.

#### **What to Expect**


We aim to make our recruitment process clear and transparent, giving you a clear understanding of what to expect at each stage.

**1. Initial screening**A first conversation with Talent Acquisition about your experience and motivation.

title: Logistics Technician
description:
**Overview**  

As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will perform cycle audits, execute incoming/outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors, and document inbound and outbound deliveries. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction and advance your career in the process.

  

This role requires you to be on-site and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised.

  

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

  

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

  

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Perform assigned tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations.
* Coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claim and process failed vendor hardware devices. This includes information processing, packaging, shipment, and receipt of return for Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) devices following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to RMA warranty process.
* Leverage process knowledge and best judgment to complete tasks with minimal direct supervision.
* Maintains a strong focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks.
* Maintains and steward up-to-date and accurate logical information within various inventory management systems (e.g., configuration management databases, asset management repositories).

* Help to reconcile and report inventory discrepancies.
* Performs destruction of data bearing devices (DBD) following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies as necessary.
* Notifies management about ordering stock shortages. Escalates any issues to management.
* Comply with security and data management policies.
* Embody our culture and values.

title: Frontier Fellow - Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**The most valuable product development happens where the product meets reality. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work at that intersection: you turn AI agents into production-ready customer solutions and bring what you learn back into the product.**


We call this role a **Frontier Fellow**: part senior engineer, part trusted technical advisor and part bridge between our customers, delivery teams and the HiveAI product team. HiveAI is Fellowmind's agent platform.

**About the role**
==================


You belong to the HiveAI product organisation, but you will do much of your work alongside our implementation teams and customers.


Building one agent is easy now. Building agents a business can rely on every day is not. That's where you come in: you take on the hardest problems in our customer projects and solve them.


The job doesn't end when the solution works. You turn what you learn into HiveAI: when relevant, functionality, patterns and components built for one customer become reusable capabilities that help the next customer and everyone else.

#### **What you will do**

* **Fix the hard parts.** Step in where agents meet real business systems, identity and users, and make them work. When shared components fall short, build your own.
* **Get AI agents into use, fast.** Work with our delivery teams from the first customer conversation to go-live. Put a working first version in front of users within days.
* **Be a front runner.** Help customers and Fellowmind teams make sound architecture decisions, challenge approaches that won't scale and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* **Shape HiveAI.** Share recurring requirements and architectural insights with the HiveAI development team.
* **Raise the bar for everyone.** Share knowledge, patterns and best practices so implementation teams can deliver HiveAI successfully on their own.
#### **What you might build**

* An agent that takes over a whole task, like handling supplier invoices or preparing quotes, and asks a person when a decision is needed.
* An agent that works across ERP, CRM and the intranet on behalf of the person who asked.
* A team of agents that share one business process, handing work to each other.
* The tools, MCP servers and integrations they need.
**Who are you?**
================

**You are an experienced engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the customer.**


You can't stop building agents, and you want people to actually use them. You'd rather show something that works than a design document. You make good decisions without all the information, and you're as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code review.

#### **You bring:**

* **Coding agents** such as GitHub Copilot as your everyday way of working, and the judgement to know which generated code will hold up in production.
* At least **4 years of professional software development experience**, with strong skills in at least one programming language and solid engineering habits: branches, pull requests and tests
* Experience **taking software into production**, where security, reliability and performance matter.
* Practical knowledge of **AI models and agents**: how they behave, what they cost, how to measure them with evals.
* Working knowledge of **Azure**, Entra ID, On-Behalf-Of and least privilege.
* Direct **customer-facing experience**, from technical discovery and workshops to architecture discussions and communication with senior stakeholders.
* A good understanding of **modern product development**, including when customer-specific functionality should become a reusable product capability.

Nobody ticks every box. If you're strong in several of these and know where to find help for the rest, we'd like to hear from you.

**What is HiveAI?**
===================


At Fellowmind, we're building **HiveAI**, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It gives enterprises a secure and scalable foundation to move beyond isolated experiments, so AI becomes part of how the business operates.


At its core is the HiveAI Agent Platform, built on Microsoft Azure, which runs AI agents securely and at scale. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, which helps organisations develop, manage and continuously improve their agents over time.


Read more about Fellowmind HiveAI.

**Why Fellowmind?**
===================


Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.


Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.

**The practicalities**
======================

**Start:** As soon as possible, and of course we'll take your notice period into account.
  

**Scope:** Full-time.
  

**Location:** This role can be based in Sweden, Denmark or the Netherlands, from one of our Fellowmind offices.
  

**Travel:** You will work with regional teams and customers across Fellowmind, so travel is a natural part of the role.
  

**Language:** Professional proficiency in **English and the local language of your country of employment: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.**  

**Process:** We start with a screening interview, followed by in-depth interviews, assessments or case work, and reference checks.

title: Cash Flow Forecasting Analyst (Fixed term)
description:
*Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.*

*If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.*


At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.


Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

#### **Cash Flow Forecasting Analyst**


Right now, we are looking for a Cash Flow Forecasting Analyst for our Business Control team.


The team is responsible for providing financial insight and control across the project, supporting effective planning and decision-making as our construction activities progress.


This is a **12-month fixed-term position**, ideally starting January 12th 2027, with the possibility of extension.


Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

* Own and maintain the rolling 13-week cash outflow forecast across construction areas and active contracts.
* Gather and consolidate payment information from Area Cost Leads, EPCM partners, Contract Managers, Procurement, Scope Owners, Accounts Payable and suppliers.
* Build and maintain cash flow models to forecast future payments under contracts and agreements.
* Forecast supplier payments, including outstanding invoices, progress payments, claims settlements and advance payments.
* Track actual cash flow against forecast, investigate variances and explain key movements.
* Reconcile forecast payments against purchase orders, payment applications and contract values.
* Prepare clear cash forecast reporting for Business Control, project leadership and Central Treasury.
* Continuously improve forecasting routines, templates and data quality while highlighting upcoming risks or changes in cash requirements.

#### **What you’ll bring**


You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking - and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.


Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:

* A B.Sc. or equivalent degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field.
* Relevant experience in cash flow forecasting, payment planning or financial planning, ideally within large construction, infrastructure, EPCM or industrial projects.
* Strong Excel skills, including financial modelling and scenario analysis.
* Good understanding of contracts and how commercial and payment terms translate into cash timing.
* Understanding of project payment cycles, including certification, invoicing, progress payments and advance payments.
* Experience coordinating financial inputs across multiple workstreams, contracts or project packages.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and follow up on inputs.
* A structured and proactive approach, with the ability to turn incomplete or unstructured information into reliable financial forecasts.


Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), cash management or working closely with Treasury is considered a plus.

**Benefits at Stegra**  

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.


You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

*Read more about Benefits at Stegra* here.

**This is Stegra**


Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.


By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

**Our Stockholm Office**


Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you’ll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city’s energy and amenities.
